name: Marshall Sheds
tagline: Barns, Sheds and Steel Buildings, Sized to the Job
description: Independent dealer of wood portable buildings and engineered steel building kits — sheds, barns, garages, workshops, barndominiums and commercial spans. Portable buildings arrive finished; steel kits ship nationwide with stamped drawings.
dealerNotice: Marshall Sheds is an independent authorized dealer. Every building we sell is produced by one of our manufacturing partners and ships direct from their plant. Steel building kits ship nationwide and are assembled on site; wood portable buildings are delivered finished inside our regional delivery area.
